Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in Homo sapiens assays against target CHEMBL1936. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join activities to assays on assay_id, and join assays to target_dictionary on tid. Filter where target_dictionary.chembl_id is 'CHEMBL1936' and assays.assay_organism is 'Homo sapiens'. Inner join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return only compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
